scope: Global attribute definitions (spec_definitions detach from category; key globally unique) with reusable attribute sets: the admin Attributes tab lists global definitions and the model-specifications form renders attributes through the model's category sets

businessFlow.subject: Admin catalog Attributes tab shows global (category-agnostic) attribute definitions with merged duplicates appearing once, and the model-specifications page still renders the correct per-category attributes through attribute sets

notes: Migration 0052/0053 made spec_definitions global (dropped category_id/required/sort_order; key now globally unique) and seeded 9 reusable attribute_sets assigned to categories. Duplicate keys that were previously defined once per category (socket in CPU+Motherboard, capacity_gb in RAM+Storage, screen_size_in in Laptop+Monitor, form_factor in Motherboard+Storage) are merged into single global definitions and appear once in the Attributes list. The Attributes create form now exposes only key/label/dataType/unit/filterable (no category/sort-order/required). The Desktop PC model (PCX Gaming Tower) specifications page still renders its six attributes (cpu, gpu, ram_gb, storage, psu_wattage, motherboard) via the desktop-pc set. Verified headed with no new console errors.
